component: Thunderbird TLS error notification and certificate-check UI

quotes.text: cert-error-ssl-connection-error = An error occurred connecting to { $hostname }.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The error switches recognize untrusted certificates explicitly and give other TLS failures separate generic text. Notification clickability and its modal fallback use canMakeException; the widget's generic failure hides view/add-exception controls. The alert-click callback itself is not guarded, so this is a source mapping, not a native backend/security guarantee. The nonexistent-server test directly checks the failure message and no visible buttons, through helpers; it was not run here.
title: Generic TLS failures have separate text and category-controlled exception actions
